newsitem.title: USA: J. Ray McDermott names Mike Lam president.
newsitem.headline: J. Ray McDermott names Mike Lam president.

text.p: J. Ray McDermott SA said on Thursday it named Mike Lam president and chief operating officer.
Lam was previously president of the company's Marine Construction Services, the company said in a statement.
He would also assume additional responsibilities for the company's European operations, J. Ray said.

J. Ray McDermott said it previously had two presidents -- Lam was president of Marine Construction and James Wildasin was president of European operations. When Wildasin died several weeks ago, J. Ray consolidated the president position.
Chairman and Chief Operating Officer James Dutt said F. Rickey Oehrlein was named vice president and group executive of European operations.
He had been vice president of project services, Dutt said.
Lam had also served as vice chairman of the board and chief operating officer of Offshore Pipelines, which merged with J. Ray in January 1995.
